texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: I’m constantly feeling like my team is moving too slowly. How can I help my team move faster?
texts.text: Q: I’m constantly feeling like my team is moving too slowly. How can I help my team move faster?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: As a founder, a PM, and even as an engineer, I ALWAYS wished we could move faster. This feeling never went away, and it won’t for you. Especially as your company grows.
texts.text: As a founder, a PM, and even as an engineer, I ALWAYS wished we could move faster. This feeling never went away, and it won’t for you. Especially as your company grows.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Though speed shouldn’t be your number one priority (vs. say impact, or picking the right problems to tackle), it is highly correlated with success. Especially in the early stages of company building.
texts.text: Though speed shouldn’t be your number one priority (vs. say impact, or picking the right problems to tackle), it is highly correlated with success. Especially in the early stages of company building.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: So how do you help your team move faster? I spoke to a number of founders, reflected on my own experience, and
texts.text: So how do you help your team move faster? I spoke to a number of founders, reflected on my own experience, and

texts.label: text
texts.orig: . Below, you’ll find twelve concrete ways to increase your team’s velocity, including dozens of examples from founders and product leaders. Here’s a handy summary:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: My advice is to review this list with your leadership team, pick 1-2 strategies, and spend the next month/quarter putting them into action. See if this makes a dent. If they do, great! If not, try something else next month/quarter. Keep experimenting.
texts.text: My advice is to review this list with your leadership team, pick 1-2 strategies, and spend the next month/quarter putting them into action. See if this makes a dent. If they do, great! If not, try something else next month/quarter. Keep experimenting.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The fewer things you focus on, the better those remaining things will go. I’ve seen this work miracles time, and time again.
texts.text: The fewer things you focus on, the better those remaining things will go. I’ve seen this work miracles time, and time again.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: “To produce at your peak level you need to work for extended periods with full concentration on a single task free from distraction.” — Cal Newport
texts.text: “To produce at your peak level you need to work for extended periods with full concentration on a single task free from distraction.” — Cal Newport

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 3. 🤝 Sync more regularly to align on priorities and unblock blockers
texts.text: 3. 🤝 Sync more regularly to align on priorities and unblock blockers

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The faster you need to go, the more regularly you should be syncing. Keep these meetings short, focused, and decision-oriented.
texts.text: The faster you need to go, the more regularly you should be syncing. Keep these meetings short, focused, and decision-oriented.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Sometimes the hardest thing is the right thing.
texts.text: Sometimes the hardest thing is the right thing.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 5. 🗣 Encourage more communication between team members
texts.text: 5. 🗣 Encourage more communication between team members

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Get cross-functional team members talking directly, especially when they’re blocked or confused about something. A quick call/DM can save days of wasted time.
texts.text: Get cross-functional team members talking directly, especially when they’re blocked or confused about something. A quick call/DM can save days of wasted time.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: For non-timely questions, avoid distracting team members by making it easy (and normal) to communicate asynchronously.
texts.text: For non-timely questions, avoid distracting team members by making it easy (and normal) to communicate asynchronously.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 7. 👀 Loop engineers (and other team members) in earlier
texts.text: 7. 👀 Loop engineers (and other team members) in earlier

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The more your team knows about the why and what, and feels the customer’s pain points, the more motivated, pro-active, and creative they’ll be. Also, they’ll lose less information in translation.
texts.text: The more your team knows about the why and what, and feels the customer’s pain points, the more motivated, pro-active, and creative they’ll be. Also, they’ll lose less information in translation.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Form cross-functional teams, with all of the resources necessary to ship, and

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 10. 🤝 Align on what success for the team means
texts.text: 10. 🤝 Align on what success for the team means

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Teams rowing in the same direction move faster.
texts.text: Teams rowing in the same direction move faster.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A bit more planning up-front can save you a lot of pain later.
texts.text: A bit more planning up-front can save you a lot of pain later.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Experimenting with new product development processes can often uncover better ways of working.
texts.text: Experimenting with new product development processes can often uncover better ways of working.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Talk to your engineers about opportunities to speed up their review, approval, and deployment process.
texts.text: Talk to your engineers about opportunities to speed up their review, approval, and deployment process.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The more confidence engineers have in their code working, the faster they’ll be able to make changes and ship.
